newsitem.title: DENMARK: Dull Danish shares set to trade in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Dull Danish shares set to trade in narrow range.

text.p: Danish share prices opened a tad higher on Monday but dealers said investors were absent due to the uncertain political situation and predicted a dull day ahead with prices narrowly rangebound.

"I don't think we are going to see any major price fluctuations. Investors are holding a low profile after Friday's collapse of the government's 1997 budget talks with the Conservatives and the threat of a no confidence motion in parliament over the Rushdie affair," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.03 point to 125.26 at 0815 gmt, after closing 0.71 point lower on Friday. +45-33969652
